journey.name: Deck editor — editing a deck must not destroy its media
journey.description:
Regression guard for the worst bug found in the UI/UX pass. Saving the deck editor republishes the whole manifest and every card record, and it used to rebuild each card as text-only (`CardSide(text = ...)`) with `coverImageRef = null` — so one save permanently deleted every card image, every audio clip and the deck cover from the homeserver.
Only reproducible on a deck that already has media, which is why no earlier journey caught it. Requires a signed-in session (journey 01).

actions.action: Tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks" and then the element with resource-id "decks_paste_cta"
Type the following two lines into the field with resource-id "paste_input": "sol - sun", "luna - moon"
Tap the element with resource-id "triage_edit", then tap the element with resource-id "triage_edit_front_image_add"
Pick the first image in the grid (resource-id: image_grid_cell) and tap the element with resource-id "image_sheet_done"
Tap the element with resource-id "triage_edit_save", then tap "triage_keep" twice to reach Publish
Tap the element with resource-id "publish_cover_change", pick an image, and confirm it with "image_sheet_done"
Enter "Media Deck" into the field with resource-id "publish_title" and tap the element with resource-id "publish_button"
Tap the element with resource-id "publish_done" and verify the deck detail screen shows the chosen cover image (not a letter placeholder)
Tap the element with resource-id "deck_edit" to open the deck editor

Verify the element with resource-id "deck_editor_cover" shows the chosen cover image, not the title's first letter — this is the one screen that can replace a cover, so it has to show the cover it is replacing (#166)

Verify the cover tile is clipped to its own square and does not spill over the "DECK TITLE" label or the title text beside it — a fill-scaled image overflows its box unless the clip is applied after the frame, and it only overflows once there is a cover to draw
Verify the tile is centred on the label + title field together, matching iOS; the character counter belongs below the whole row, not in the column beside the cover
Change the deck title to "Media Deck Renamed" and save it
Verify the deck detail screen still shows the cover image — it must NOT have reverted to a letter placeholder
Open the deck editor again and verify the first card still shows its image indicator, and that "deck_editor_cover" still shows the cover

Tap "deck_editor_cover", tap "image_pick_gallery", pick a photo, and verify the cover box shows it immediately; save, reopen the editor, and verify the box shows that photo again — a gallery cover is a homeserver blob with no URL, so it takes a different path to the screen than an Unsplash one

On an account that owns no decks, the same checks can be reached without publishing one: follow any deck from Discover, tap "deck_edit" on it, name the copy and confirm (#254), then open the copy's editor. A copy's cover is pinned to the source author's blob, which is the same Base64 path a gallery cover takes.
